legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors, assigns, and personal representatives.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Assignee against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from any breach of the Original Contract.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising from this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for closing the transaction and ensuring that all necessary documents are recorded in the land records of New Castle County, Delaware.
